summary: Frontend-only test of the 3 new landing-page features (alert sound toggle, severity filter, open the clicked case) plus regressions. All requested flows pass. Sound toggle: starts MUTED with localStorage alert_sound='off'. Click switches it to ON ('on'), it stays ON after reload, and a second click mutes it again. The queue ran about 9s with sound ON and no WebAudio/page errors appeared. Severity filter: each of critical/high/medium/low shows only matching rows and the row count equals alert-count-*. Clicking the same counter again clears the filter (all 8 rows back). Hovering pauses the queue (8->8 rows over 5s). Clicking a row opens alert-signup-prompt. Sign-up from SOC145 -> register -> onboarding SOC L1 -> continue lands on /app/challenges with the 'Mass File Rename on File Server' sheet open, pending_case is cleared, and a reload does not reopen the sheet. Login as student from SOC112/SOC151/SOC134/SOC101/SOC201/SOC177 opens the right case each time (bf/lat/mal/phish/phish/phish). Logging in without clicking an alert goes to /app. Opening and submitting a challenge still works (score 89/100).

ui_bugs.issue: A new alert enters every 2.2s and the list re-lays out, so a click made just as it arrives can open the row that slid into place. Hover-pause makes this rare for real mouse users. It reproduced once in automation (aimed at SOC101, opened SOC134).

issues: alert-feed-status text 'filter: <sev>' almost never shows. The user is hovering the feed when they click a counter, so the queue is paused and the paused text takes priority. Consider showing the filter label even while paused.
Non-selected counters drop to opacity-40 while a filter is on, so the small uppercase labels (e.g. LOW) become very low contrast.
Severity on the landing page differs from the challenge it opens: SOC112 is High on the landing page but Medium in the challenge, and SOC101 is Critical vs High. Users may notice.

action_items: Optional: show the active filter label even while the queue is paused
Optional: make landing-page alert severities match the challenge severities for SOC112 and SOC101

Optional: clear a stale pending_case. It is only removed on a successful onboarded login/onboarding, so a user who clicks 'Investigate' and leaves will have a case opened on any later login. Admin/instructor logins also go to /app/challenges if a pending_case exists, because pending takes priority over role routing.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx: nav(pending || role routing) sends admin/instructor to /app/challenges when pending_case is set. Consider applying pending only for students.
ping() creates a new AudioContext per ping (closed onended). Acceptable, but reusing one context is cleaner.
SheetContent in Challenges.jsx has no data-testid; tests used [role=dialog].
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test user test_case_<ts>@example.com and deleted it from MongoDB afterwards. Student account got a submission on ch-bf-01 from the regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use [role=dialog] for the challenge sheet. To click a specific hero alert reliably, hover the feed first (it pauses), then click. pending_case lives in localStorage. Anonymous landing loads show expected 401 console errors from the auth/me check.
